content: Anthony Mackie’s Sam Wilson/Captain America will be leading the Avengers in Avengers: Doomsday, guiding Thor (Chris Hemsworth), Ant-Man (Paul Rudd), Shang-Chi (Simu Liu), and Falcon (Danny Ramirez) in the fight against Doctor Doom. But while Sam is getting a big promotion, Mackie said he was lied to about his next starring role.
